failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: Test teardown failed with EBUSY resource busy/locked error removing a temp workspace directory on Windows. PR only modifies Aspire.Cli SDK dump restore logic, unrelated to VS Code extension code. Matches recurring known flaky pattern for this shard (21 prior occurrences), a filesystem cleanup race condition on Windows CI runners.
